title: Stretching
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Stretch slowly to calm music. No bouncing. Show each position: standing, sitting, kneeling, lying.

skills.key_step: The child names the body parts, directions and positions of stretching and stretches slowly without bouncing.

misconceptions.ask: How do you stretch your legs safely?
misconceptions.repair: Reach slowly, count to five and hold.

misconceptions.ask: Stretch sideways. Which way do your arms go?
misconceptions.repair: Stand between two friends and reach towards each.

misconceptions.ask: Can you stretch while sitting or lying down?
misconceptions.repair: Do one stretch in each position.
Stretch until you feel a gentle pull, then stop.

checks.question: Name a direction of stretching.
checks.answer: any of: upwards, forward, backwards, sideways

checks.question: Should you bounce when you stretch?
